body: Free ang event, so ang tunay na cost ay engineer-hours. Best filter: huwag ubusin ang araw sa generic DX talks. Piliin lang ang sessions na may before/after numbers—model setup time, solver/runtime, physical-test correlation, integration hours, at maintenance burden. Kapag walang measured baseline, scouting value lang iyon. Since online exhibits remain through Sept. 3, puwedeng i-triage muna today bago mag-invest ng mas maraming oras.
